stem:
Sia reads the school notice "$18\%$ of the class voted for the garden club."

Which claim correctly states what $18\%$ means?

options.text: $18\%$ means $18$ out of every $10$ students in the class.
$18\%$ means $18$ out of every $100$ students in the class.
$18\%$ means $100$ out of every $18$ students in the class.
$18\%$ means $18$ students in total, with no reference to the whole class.

teacher.key_rationale: x% means x/100 of the chosen whole, so 18% is 18 per 100. Per 10 drops the hundredths base; 100 per 18 reverses the fraction; a bare headcount drops the whole.
